profile_data.raw_text:
GOWTHAM S
Python Full Stack Developer
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India  |  gowthamcodes225@gmail.com  |  +91-7200697310
GitHub: gowthamcodes225   |   LinkedIn: gowtham-s-2205gs   |   LeetCode: sGowthamCodes
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Third-year B.Sc. Computer Science student and Python Full Stack Developer with hands-on internship experience and a strong portfolio of production-style full stack projects. Skilled in building responsive frontends with React and Next.js, and robust backends with Python, Django, and MySQL. Experienced in JWT-based authentication, role-based access control, REST APIs, and cloud deployment (Render, Vercel, GitHub Pages). Passionate about building AI-integrated, real-world solutions such as an emergency triage and hospital bed availability network.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript
Frontend: HTML, CSS, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Framer Motion
Backend: Django, Django REST Framework (DRF), REST APIs, JWT Authentication (SimpleJWT)
Database: MySQL
Tools & Platforms: Git, GitHub, Vite, Vercel, Render, GitHub Pages, Three.js / React Three Fiber
EXPERIENCE
Web Development Intern  |  Infogro Technology, Chennai
Worked on live web development tasks, strengthening practical skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and full stack workflows.
Collaborated in a professional team environment, gaining exposure to real-world project timelines and code practices.
KEY PROJECTS
MediQueue – AI Emergency Triage & Hospital Bed Network  |  Final Year Project / Hackathon
Designing an AI-powered platform connecting patients, hospital staff, and ambulance drivers for real-time emergency triage and live hospital bed availability.
Built for competitive MNC internship selection and as a hackathon submission, targeting practical healthcare logistics problems.
Campus Connect – Full Stack College Platform  |  Personal Project
Built a full stack college platform using Django + DRF (backend) and React + Vite + Tailwind CSS (frontend), backed by MySQL.
Implemented 5 Django apps with JWT authentication (SimpleJWT) and role-based access control (RBAC).
Designed a 3D animated hero section with post-processing visual effects; deployed backend on Render and frontend on Vercel.
Luxury Hotel Campus – 3D Hostel Exploration Website  |  Personal Project
Built a premium AAA-quality 3D exploration website using React, Three.js, React Three Fiber, and Framer Motion with GLB-based interactive room walkthroughs.
EDUCATION
B.Sc. Computer Science  |  St. Joseph's College of Arts & Science, Kovur, Chennai (University of Madras)	 2024 – 2027
CERTIFICATIONS
Sololearn – Web Development Certification
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Preparing for SSC CGL (e.g., Income Tax Inspector) as a competitive government-job backup path.
